Colocalized, triangulated plasma proteins implicate Wnt, extracellular-matrix and hormonal pathways in fibroid risk. PARP1 is the most tissue-supported repurposing hypothesis, but its colocalization is prior-sensitive and PARP inhibitors carry oncology-grade toxicity, so it is not a ready therapy for reproductive-age women.
